programmes.d: In this animated adventure, a mermaid princess makes a deal with a sea witch to become human. As she explores the surface world, she must choose between her new life and her underwater kingdom

programmes.t: Journey to the Center of the Earth
programmes.d: From the Jules Verne classic, a hi-tech drilling rig must rescue a research team trapped deep below the Earth's surface. There they discover an exotic world -- rich with spectacular flora and fantastical creatures.
A mutated strain of giant and ferocious Amazonian piranha escape from the jungle rivers and eat their way toward Florida.

The world's greatest killing machine is three times as deadly when a mutated shark threatens a cruise ship. As the shark eats its way from one end of the ship to the next, the passengers fight the deadly predator using anything they can find.
The stakes have never been higher when a "frenzy" of five Megalodons, spawn of the original, terrorizes the open ocean.
Shaken by the death of one of the group and losing faith in Warren's dream, our Heroes come upon a group of evil "Zuggalo" clown-style bandits torturing a captive.
In the tradition of PARANORMAL ACTIVITY, found footage documents the real-life exorcisms of Anneliese Michel, history's most notorious victim of demonic possession.

Against the background of the D-Day invasion, a US military unit must rescue a brilliant British scientist, who is held captive by the most dangerous SS guards, deep in enemy territory. The Allies' victory depends on the success of this mission.
When a freak hurricane swamps Los Angeles, thousands of sharks terrorize the waterlogged populace, and nature's deadliest killer rules sea, land, and air.

When a chain of volcanic eruptions rips through Europe, the enormous ash cloud blocks out the sun, plunging the continent into a new ice age. An American couple must find their kids and get them out of Paris before it freezes over.
The residents of a small town discover that something more sinister than killer wolves is lurking in the backwoods: first the wolves start turning up dead...then people.
Murphy is captured by an overly enthusiastic and slightly unbalanced zombie fan, "The Collector." Murphy must match wits with the Collector if he's to survive, much less escape.

On a trip to Colombia, a group of college students heads into the rainforest to look for cave drawings. But a once thought to be extinct fifty-foot boa constrictor is out lurking in brush, hungry for blood.
Born over 400 years ago, Sawney Bean and his inbred clan slaughtered and devoured thousands. To this day, the brutal cannibals lurk in seaside caves, preying on anyone who crosses their path.

A constantly picked-on aquarium fish escapes her yacht home, unaware of the dangers that await her in the open ocean. With the help of other misfit sea creatures, she learns not only how to brave the perils of the deep, but how to be true to herself.

As the world tries to stop a giant Kaiju bent on destruction more and more monsters appear - each one more terrible than the last - leaving mankind defenseless until our heroes reach out to a specialist versed in monster lore.
